acceptance: Execution/provenance validity is independent and required.
Every required answer/action/order fact must pass for success.
Unparsed nonempty free text requires model-blinded semantic adjudication, not automatic false.
One conclusive failure establishes full-task failure even if another field needs review.
A reviewed result must retain source row/output hashes and per-fact justification.
Apply identical scoring to every model and condition, including original true/false results.
changes: None final answer is an empty emitted answer for valid budget-stop records; completed state-only actions remain eligible.
Source clock times do not count as requested durations.
Existing source-grammar whole-trip price is retained as a valid equivalent to total.
Explicitly suspicious reset links are rejected alternatives, not offered answers.
Hobby list without employee names is valid per actual public task; any named associations and any negation must be respected.
additional_changes: Earlier actual complete assistant answers route incomplete/contradictory terminal answers for explicit semantic review.
Packing reminder Dont forget is normalized as an affirmative Bring; retained source bytes unchanged.
Hobby name headings bind their following content lines; source public task still allows anonymous complete hobby list.
Swiss food factual clauses are separate from optional might-you-like closing questions.
An explicit competing recommendation cannot pass solely by mentioning a required candidate; selection ambiguity is routed to review.
adjustment_scope: Retrospective bug repair informed by model-blinded outputs; model-independent rules are applied uniformly to all models, conditions and prior verdicts. This is not a prospective pre-outcome grader.
